result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M for the data-processing activities, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, requiring coverage for one year after the Term and adding an express own-expense obligation go beyond the supplied position. The redline also unnecessarily reorders existing subsection (iii) ahead of the Section 14 heading and inserts the insurance provision without a subsection designation, creating avoidable structural and numbering defects. The existing substantive language is otherwise preserved.
